summary_en: Shionogi corrected numerical errors in its October 29, 2026 announcement of dividend increase for fiscal year ending March 2027, with adjustments to EPS forecasts and year-over-year growth rates due to inconsistencies with interim financial statements.
title_en: Correction Notice Regarding Revisions to FY2027 Performance and Annual Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase Announced October 29, 2026)
translation_en_brief:
Shionogi & Co., Ltd. issued a correction notice on October 30, 2026 regarding its dividend guidance announced the previous day. The company identified numerical errors in its earnings forecast and dividend announcement for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, stemming from inconsistencies with the interim financial results disclosed simultaneously.

The corrections were limited to specific data points: basic earnings per share (EPS) was adjusted from 249.72 yen to 249.67 yen, and the year-over-year growth rate for revenue was corrected from +46.1% to +44.1%. These technical adjustments did not affect the company's core performance forecasts, which maintain revenue guidance of 720.0 billion yen, operating profit of 230.0 billion yen, and net income attributable to parent of 212.5 billion yen. The company confirmed that these corrections involved only disclosure recording errors and had no impact on the consolidated financial statements themselves.

The correction underscores the importance of ensuring consistency across simultaneous financial disclosures, particularly when multiple announcements are released on the same date covering overlapping fiscal periods.
